verdict.rationale: Column supports Custom Roles for granular, least-privilege access control 'down to specific bank accounts, transfer types, and other features' and API keys that are locked to sandbox or live mode at creation, giving developers (including AI agents calling the API) scoped credentials. Community feedback corroborates fine-grained permissioning (e.g., per-account-number ACH permissions/limits). Missing for 10: explicit agent-specific tooling (e.g., short-lived/ephemeral tokens designed for autonomous agents) and independent hands-on verification of the Custom Roles feature beyond docs.
